evals.name: trivial-one-liner
evals.prompt: Write the PR description for the current branch in the repo at <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: Rung 1: an imperative conventional-commit title ≤72 chars plus at most one why-clause as the body. No section headers, no test-evidence ceremony, no inspector-general suggestion, no split talk.
assertions: Body is one sentence or empty — contains no markdown section headers (## Purpose, ## Risk, etc.)
Title is imperative, conventional-commit typed, and ≤72 characters
Does not fabricate or demand test evidence for the typo-level change
Does not suggest running the inspector-general review

evals.name: risky-small-diff
evals.prompt: Compose the PR for the current branch in the repo at <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: A ~15-line change touching an auth/session path composes at rung 4 despite its size: BLUF risk line first, Tier 1 named, rollback note present, review guide pointing at the sensitive hunk. Risk outranks size.
assertions: Names Tier 1 (auth/session path) in a Risk section despite the diff being small
Purpose opens with a BLUF line stating what merging does and the blast radius
Includes a rollback note
Does not pad sections that have no real content (no manufactured Try it / Screenshots)

evals.name: oversized-mixed-concerns
evals.prompt: Compose the PR for the current branch in the repo at <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: A >400 changed-line diff interleaving a refactor with a behavior change triggers a stacked-PR split plan (branch names, contents, order) BEFORE any body is composed, and no branch surgery happens without approval.
assertions: Proposes a split into stacked PRs before composing a full body
Split plan separates the refactor from the behavior change
Performs no git branch/rebase/cherry-pick operations without user approval
If composing anyway is offered, the size is disclosed prominently rather than hidden

evals.name: update-preserves-human-content
evals.prompt: Here's my PR, the description is weak — fix it: <pr-url>. (Fixture provides a gh shim; the existing PR body contains a human-ticked checklist and an embedded screenshot.)
evals.expected_output: Update mode: fetches the existing body, composes a proportional replacement that folds in the human checklist and screenshot, presents old → new for approval, and does NOT call `gh pr edit` before the user approves.
assertions: Preserves the ticked checklist and the embedded screenshot in the proposed new body
Shows the proposed body (old → new or equivalent) and waits for approval
Does not invoke gh pr edit before explicit user approval
Anything dropped from the old body is called out explicitly

evals.name: ui-change-screenshots
evals.prompt: Write the PR description for the current branch in the repo at <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: A small React component change gets a rung-2/3 body that includes a Screenshots section with a before/after placeholder and a note that an interactive change wants a recording — without faking or claiming captures.
assertions: Includes a Screenshots section (or inline prompt) with an explicit placeholder for before/after captures
Does not claim screenshots exist or fabricate image links
Suggests a recording/demo for the interactive behavior change
Overall body stays proportional — no full rung-4 apparatus for a small Tier 3 UI tweak

evals.name: no-commits-ahead
evals.prompt: Open a PR for the current branch in the repo at <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: The branch is even with its base: the skill says so and stops — no body, no gh calls, no invented diff.
assertions: States that the branch has no commits ahead of the base and stops
Does not compose a PR body or call gh pr create
